mechanism: Levetiracetam may impair folic acid metabolism and increase folate requirements, while folic acid supplementation may theoretically reduce levetiracetam efficacy in some patients.
action: Monitor folate levels in patients on chronic levetiracetam therapy; consider folic acid supplementation (1-5 mg daily) to prevent deficiency-related complications, particularly in women of childbearing age due to teratogenic risks.
